# oneuptime_network_interface_data (Data Source)

Network interface data data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oneuptime_network_interface_data" "example" {
  name = "example-network_interface_data"
}
```

## Schema

- `id` (String) Identifier to filter by. Optional.
- `name` (String) Name to filter by. Computed.
- `created_at` (String) A date time object.. Computed.
